generated.title: Nairobi pluvial flood overview
generated.briefing: The synthetic exposure portfolio shows the highest concentrations of flood loss in low-lying and drainage-constrained informal settlements, especially around Kibera, Mathare, and Mukuru. The hazard proxy underestimates some river-adjacent and drainage-blocked hotspots, so the report should be treated as decision support rather than a calibrated hydrological model.

Risk briefing

Fluvial and surface-water vulnerability is concentrated where drainage and terrain combine to increase flood propensity.
